overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by convening in executive session under the nonunion personnel purpose to discuss an ambulance vendor contract; the claim about unnoticed topics was not found to be a violation because no actual deliberation on them occurred.

allegations.summary: Board convened in executive session under the nonunion personnel purpose to discuss ambulance services vendor contract; AG reviewed purpose as a threshold matter.
allegations.key_passage: A discussion of vendor or service contracts, such as retaining ambulance services from an outside vendor, is not appropriate for executive session under Purpose 2.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged discussion of unnoticed topics (treasurer and assistant treasurer hours, administrative assistant) during the executive session, outside the stated purpose.
allegations.key_passage: Where a public body does not actually engage in any deliberation on a particular topic, it cannot violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to the sufficiency of the meeting notice.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Board that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
